DDR3 Byte Lane Length Matching

The file `/home/user/Desktop/ddr3.kicad_pcb` contains a DDR3 byte lane with 11 nets routed on F.Cu: DQS_P, DQS_N (the reference pair at 35 mm each), DQ0-DQ7, and DM. The DQ and DM traces are currently unmatched, ranging from approximately 28 mm to 34 mm.

Add serpentine segments to the DQ0-DQ7 and DM nets to match the DQS reference length. Do NOT modify the DQS_P or DQS_N traces.

Requirements:
1. The maximum minus minimum length across all 11 nets must be <= 150 um.
2. DQS_P and DQS_N lengths must remain within +/-0.1 mm of their input values.
3. Serpentine bends must maintain at least 0.2 mm spacing between net traces (3H rule for 0.1 mm trace width); bends must stay within 1.5 mm of their track's y-center.
4. All segments must remain on F.Cu.
5. The output file must parse as a valid KiCad 9 PCB s-expression.
6. Also write `/home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg` as the native KiCad CLI F.Cu SVG export of your final board.

Write /home/user/Desktop/ddr3.kicad_pcb and /home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg.
source: JEDEC DDR3 / DDR4 Design Guidelines (DDR3 fly-by), TI / Analog Devices / Nordic / Microchip PCB layout app notes (Micron DDR3 layout guideline), KiCad 9 Official Documentation - PCB Editor / CLI (`kicad-cli pcb export svg`)
